criteria.description: Exactly one h1, one description, two CTAs (primary and secondary), and one rounded cover image
Copy precedes media in a mobile stack and both peers form an equal vertically aligned split at large widths
Semantic links, meaningful image alternative, visible focus, 44px touch targets, WCAG 2.1 AA, and no overflow
Light/dark tokens, reduced motion, and JavaScript-disabled completeness
Codex independently reviews fresh desktop and mobile captures plus the DOM/CSS cascade
